verdicts.reason: A drops the 'Quiet Hours' book cover, the original's key image. Its Inkwell & Lantern logo is shrunk to an illegible speck in the top-left corner, the card leaves dead space on the left, and the legal line is tiny and wraps awkwardly. B keeps the book cover, the full-size logo and a clear centred hierarchy (eyebrow, headline, body copy, CTA, legal), arranged as a proper left-to-right banner. Its flaws are minor: the card bleeds off the top, right and bottom edges, so only its left corners are rounded; the text block is tight vertically; and the one-line body copy is long.
